statement: Pinned CWiid libcwiid cwiid_open and listener use AF_BLUETOOTH SOCK_SEQPACKET BTPROTO_L2CAP control and interrupt channels, with optional inquiry, not Linux hidraw or evdev. Neither current UHID-Bluetooth nor uinput realization creates the required L2CAP endpoint; wminput may generate new system inputs only *after* a real Bluetooth-side CWiid connection.

applicability.revision: Pinned software consumer; retail Wii Remote revision not measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer; CWiid fadf11e connect.c 34-148; no examined CWiid Linux hidraw backend; no physical test.
